thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 [ALERT] High 5xx rate observed for ingress in euc1-c (ALB+Envoy). 5xx spike > 15% over baseline for the past 3m. Affected routes: /api/v1/generate, /chat. Paging rotation: @samira, @carlos oncall.

samira: grabbing this. seeing lots of Envoy upstream CONNRESET in logs. beginning triage.

carlos: I'm online. any customer-facing tickets? I see synthetic down alerts from US-East customers.

samira: yes, PagerDuty shows ~30 customers with elevated error rates, some experiencing timeouts. Postmortem-runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingress-5xx

mei: tagged in since this smells like AZ networking flakiness. euc1-c AZ has had minor route flaps in the last 24h.

devops-sre: confirming a small spike in ALB 5xx at the same time window. ALB logs show target group healthcheck errors 502/503 from NLB->Envoy backends. possible conntrack/keepalive issue.

samira: rolling quick mitigations:
- draining a subset of hosts in euc1-c from ALB
- increasing envoy keepalive timeout
- pushing a temporary weighted shift in Route53 to euc2 (20% for now)

carlos: how are you draining? command?

samira: `aws elbv2 modify-target-group --target-group-arn ... --health-check-enabled false` then remove targets. doing it via autoscaling detach for a few hosts.

oncall-bot: @carlos acknowledged the page. Estimated ETA for first recovery action: 5m.

lucy: FYI customers hitting higher latencies are mostly on long-poll websocket flows -> NAT timeouts could cause resets.

mei: checking kernel conntrack metrics on hosts in euc1-c: CT table entries peaking, several retries. Might be ephemeral port exhaustion from a routing flap.

devops-sre: running `ss -s` and `sudo cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max`. also checking iptables counts.

samira: scaled egress proxy pool +10 in euc1-c to reduce connection reuse pressure. monitoring.

carlos: Route53 shift to euc2 applied (weight 20 -> euc2). pushing more if errors persist.

samira: Service errors dropped from 16% -> 6% after draining 3 nodes and shifting 20% traffic. still seeing occasional spikes at ~30s intervals.

mei: looks like BGP flap between provider and our euc1-c fabric for a subset of racks. Network team escalated to cloud provider. ticket #CLD-9821.

devops-sre: temporary workaround: reduced envoy max-conns per upstream from 2000 -> 800, and lowered idle timeout to 15s to force faster teardown of broken sockets. applied via config rollout to 30% first.

samira: rolled envoy config to 30% of euc1 hosts. observing.

oncall-bot: incoming SLA impact notice: 32 customers possibly impacted, highest severity: 5 customers with >30% error.

lucy: posting a short customer communication draft to #support-desk: "We are aware of intermittent 5xx errors for API & chat in euc1; we're mitigating by shifting traffic and restarting a subset of edge nodes. No data loss; updates to follow." Thoughts?

carlos: good. add estimated ETA 1h and mention engineering working with cloud provider.

mei: cloud provider confirmed a partial fabric misconfiguration affecting TCP resets to a handful of racks. They are rolling a correction. ETA 45m.

samira: continuing ops checklist:
- keep shifting weights only if errors remain >5%
- avoid full failover to euc2 to prevent cold caches
- keep healthcheck interval high enough so we don't thrash LB

devops-sre: added short-lived firewall rule to allow additional ephemeral ports from NLB to backends to reduce connection resets while cloud provider fixes BGP adjacencies.

samira: metrics trending down to 2.3% 5xx with euc2 weight at 35%. Customer impact still limited but intermittent.

carlos: starting incident summary for PagerDuty post: timeline + actions + customer impact.

lucy: support notified. asked for list of affected customer org_ids so CS can proactively reach out.

oncall-bot: @samira you have been on call for 49m. next on-call @carlos will take handoff in 10m.

samira: prepping handoff message in 5. will include runbook run, mitigation flags, and outstanding cloud provider ticket.

samira: HANDOFF: current state: euc1-c partial network restore in progress by provider. mitigations applied: drained 3 hosts, envoy config rollback ready, Route53 weight at 35% to euc2, firewall tweak, scaled egress proxies +10. Customer impact: intermittent 5xx affecting ~12 non-critical customers, 5 high-rate customers. Next steps for oncall: monitor 5xx rate, do not increase weight to euc2 beyond 50% without PM approval, coordinate with cloud provider for confirmation of BGP fix. logs are in https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/ingress/5xx-spike

carlos: taking handoff. I'll keep watch and coordinate with network team. Samira great work.

devops-sre: cloud provider updated: fix deployed to 40% of affected racks. monitoring for BGP stability. will update.

mei: after this stabilizes we should schedule a follow-up: adjust ALB healthcheck semantics (longer timeout, fewer failures) + fix conntrack tuning in AMI bake.

lucy: support asked for customer impact timeline (start/end) to include in comms. samira, can you pin the start ts?

samira: start ~2314499800 (approx). I'll update once we see fully healthy -> expected in next 30-45m.

oncall-bot: incident severity reduced to S2. continue monitoring.

carlos: 30m update: 5xx now <1% after provider fixed remaining racks and we shifted weight back to euc1 to 10%. We'll keep monitoring for 1h before closing.

samira: adding short retro items: 1) add probe for BGP instability per-AZ, 2) automate weighted Route53 rollback based on aggregated 5xx threshold, 3) include conntrack tuning in infra docs.

devops-sre: creating follow-up ticket INFRA-4526 for conntrack AMI bake. assigned to infra team.

lucy: sending customer update: "Issue mitigated, partial traffic restored to euc1; we will monitor to ensure full recovery. No action required from customers." sending now.

carlos: closing note: if anything reappears, escalate to S1 and engage network escalation bridge. Thanks team.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed by @carlos (manual).
